question: The marked price of a fan is ₹620. Due to off season, a discount of 15% is allowed. The selling price of the fan is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

multiplier **SP** = **MP** × (100 − **D%**) ÷ 100

**SP** = 620 × (100 − 15) ÷ 100

**SP** = 620 × 85 ÷ 100 = 62 × 8.5

**SP** = 527

**∴ The correct answer is ₹527.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Marked Price (MP)** = ₹620, **Discount Percentage (D%)** = 15%
Formulas: **Discount** = (**D%** ÷ 100) × **MP** | **SP** = **MP** − **Discount**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15b8230bce95ce93965d374e1d0762c8150c29dbec7f1343096158ec55503de3.png] 
⇒ **Discount Value** = (15 ÷ 100) × 620
⇒ **Discount Value** = 0.15 × 620 = 93
⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = 620 − 93
⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = 527

**∴ The correct answer is ₹527.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

The **Marked Price** is the price printed on the label. **Discount** is always calculated on the **MP** unless specified otherwise.

Effective Price

The **Selling Price** is the actual amount a customer pays after the **Discount** is deducted from the **Marked Price**.
